from pathlib import Path
from repo_workflow.command_grammar import Context, parse_tokens
from repo_workflow.public_commands import COMMANDS
ctx = Context(Path('.'), legal_only=False)
assert parse_tokens(COMMANDS, ctx, ['start', '230']) == ('start', '230')
assert parse_tokens(COMMANDS, ctx, ['start', 'lane', '225']) == ('start', 'lane', '225')
